text:
incident-bot: [PAGER] 1749008765 - Elevated 5xx rate on hosted inference: /v1/generate (model_generate). Error spike started ~1749008700. Affected: ~12% of requests in us-west-2. Severity: P2. Paging oncall (tariq).

Tariq: on it. grabbing context now. can someone post recent deploy activity and if any config rollbacks occurred?

patrick_eng: there was an emergency rollback of cache-config at 1749008600 to revert an unrelated mem issue. rolling back a flag that reduced shard cache size. can reproduce locally a 503 when cache hits go negative.

leah_prodops: thanks @patrick_eng. is the failure the runtime rejecting requests or model returning 5xx? logs show "kv_cache_eviction: underflow" in runtime.

patrick_eng: runtime rejects with 503; stack shows eviction race in cache manager after rollback. pushing a hotfix to re-add bounds-checking now.

Tariq: okay. short term mitigation: 1) re-enable increased cache size (temporary) via infra toggle, 2) block traffic to a small subset of customers for safety. Maria, can you draft a customer-facing note for affected tenants?

maria_cs: draft below — please tweak.

maria_cs: "Hi [Customer], we experienced elevated errors for text generation from 13:45–14:13 UTC impacting ~12% of requests in us-west-2. Root cause: cache configuration rollback that triggered a runtime eviction bug, causing transient 503s. We mitigated by reapplying a safe cache size and deploying a fix; full resolution at 14:13 UTC. We're following up with an RCA and preventative actions. Apologies for the interruption; we're available for calls if needed. — Maria, CS"

Tariq: good. add note about any message-level retries to avoid duplicate charges? also include status page snippet.

leah_prodops: status page update (post now):

```
Service: Hosted Inference (generate)
Impact: Elevated 5xx rate impacting a subset of requests in us-west-2.
Start: 2024-11-02 13:45:00 UTC
Update: Mitigated at 2024-11-02 14:13:00 UTC by reapplying safe cache sizing and deploying a runtime bounds-check patch. No ongoing impact.
Next steps: Full RCA to be published within 72 hours. If you continue to see 503s, contact support.
```

patrick_eng: hotfix deployed at 14:10 UTC, feature flag flipped at 14:12, traffic fully restored to normal by 14:13. We'll run a canary for 30m.

incident-bot: incident status updated: mitigated -> monitoring.

Tara_legal: @maria_cs quick note: avoid promising credits in the first customer message. We can mention "investigating impact and next steps" and then follow up with any credit/compensation after internal review.

maria_cs: ack. I'll remove credit language in the first note.

Tariq: ACTIONS: 1) Patrick to open GH PR with root cause fix + unit test for eviction (done). 2) Leah to coordinate status page & update timeline (in progress). 3) Maria to send customer note with revised wording (pending). 4) Ops to run targeted replay for affected customers to verify no data loss (pending). Please confirm ETA on full RCA.

patrick_eng: RCA draft: "Cause: a recent rollback of cache sizing flag reintroduced an off-by-one bounds condition in the KV cache eviction path. Under certain concurrent workloads eviction counter underflowed causing the runtime to return 503. Fix: add bounds checks, harden unit tests, add canary and telemetry for eviction counter, and add infra guardrails to prevent flag rollback without canary. Preventative actions: 1) add regression test covering concurrent eviction; 2) safeguard flag rollbacks with automated canary and size checks; 3) alerting for eviction counter anomalies; 4) ops runbook to scale cache size quickly during incident."

leah_prodops: timeline clarification for customer RCA:
- 13:43 UTC: Monitoring alert for increased 5xx.
- 13:45 UTC: incident-bot paged oncall (tariq).
- 13:47 UTC: quick triage shows recent config rollback at 13:43–13:44 window.
- 13:55 UTC: decision to reapply previous cache sizing as temporary mitigation.
- 14:10 UTC: runtime hotfix deployed.
- 14:12 UTC: infra flag flipped to previous cache size.
- 14:13 UTC: traffic normalized; monitoring returned to baseline by 14:20 UTC.

maria_cs: I'll send the customer note now with adjusted language. Copy of message sent to affected tenants: "We identified and mitigated elevated 5xx errors between 13:45–14:13 UTC caused by a configuration rollback that triggered a runtime cache eviction bug. The issue is mitigated; full RCA and preventive actions will follow. Reach out if you want a call."

Tara_legal: thanks. once RCA is final, legal wants to review any compensation language before we offer credits.

Tariq: closing loop: monitoring for 2 hours; if stable we move to post-incident handoff and publish RCA in 72h. Good work everyone. :thumbsup: 

incident-bot: Incident 1749008765 moved to resolved (monitoring->resolved) at 1749009400.
